items.title: Ford is 'officially in the battery business' as its first Fathom cells ship — built on Chinese tech
items.summary: Ford announced on Wednesday the first lithium iron phosphate battery cells are coming off the line at its BlueOval Battery Park Michigan, part of a plan that licenses China's CATL battery designs.

items.title: Ford Starts Making EV Battery Cells in Michigan With China's CATL Technology

items.title: Ford begins EV battery cell production in the U.S. with China’s tech
items.summary: Investing.com -- Ford Motor has begun manufacturing battery cells at its Michigan facility for upcoming electric vehicles, using technology licensed from Chinese battery manufacturer CATL.

items.title: Ford CFO: Path to EV profitability could run through new UEV platform

items.title: Ford Motor Sees Flat 2027 Earnings as Cost Cuts Offset $2 Billion Headwind
items.summary: Ford Motor (NYSE:F) expects adjusted earnings before interest and taxes to be roughly flat in 2027, with cost reductions, improved vehicle placement and growth in services helping offset inflation and other headwinds, Chief Financial Officer Sherry House said.
